description: This file defines the interface 'MatcherProcessorInterface' within the Goteo project, specifying methods for processing matchers, managing context objects (Matcher, Project, Invest, PaymentMethod), and retrieving event listeners.

classes.name: MatcherProcessorInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for matcher processors, including methods for identification, description, handling matchers, managing context objects, and event listeners.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for this processor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a friendly name for this processor.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns a human-understandable full description of the processor's rules.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the processor handles a given Matcher campaign.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the processor for the matcher.

methods.name: getVarLabels
methods.description: Returns an array of custom variable labels used by the processor.

methods.name: getVars
methods.description: Gets the current custom variables for this processor.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount to be added, with an error message if zero.

methods.name: getInvests
methods.description: Returns a list of additional invests based on total amount.

methods.name: getAppEventListeners
methods.description: Returns event listeners for the application service container.

methods.name: getConsoleEventListeners
methods.description: Returns event listeners for the console dispatcher (cron).
